description: Defines an enum 'NoteCategory' for categorizing notes with extension helpers for conversion and a list of user categories.

classes.name: NoteCategory
classes.description: An enumeration representing different note categories such as 'All', 'Work', 'Personal', 'Ideas', and 'Archive'.

classes.name: NoteCategoryExtension
classes.description: An extension that provides helper methods for the 'NoteCategory' enum, including converting to display strings and parsing from codes.

methods.name: toDisplayString
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string representing the note category.

methods.name: toStringCode
methods.description: Returns the string name of the category, suitable for code or storage.

methods.name: fromCode
methods.description: Converts a dynamic code to a 'NoteCategory' enum value, defaulting to 'all' if no match.
